description:
Redwood Inference is seeing increasing enterprise deal volume where security/compliance review and formal RFPs are gating procurement for Dedicated and Private deployments. The goal of this project is to refresh the Enterprise Security Enablement Kit used by Sales, Solutions Engineering, Security/GRC, and Customer Success: (1) an up-to-date security FAQ aligned to current product capabilities (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), (2) refreshed compliance one-pagers (SOC 2 posture, ISO alignment, data residency/retention, encryption/KMS, audit logging, SSO/RBAC), and (3) a standardized RFP response library with approved language and an internal process for maintaining claims.

Scope includes: auditing existing customer-facing claims, incorporating recurring questions from sales calls and support tickets, drafting updated artifacts in Google Drive, running cross-functional reviews (Security/GRC, Product Security PM, Solutions Engineering, Legal/Finance where contractual language appears), publishing final versions to Confluence sales enablement and security/compliance spaces, and updating any public-facing documentation (redwood-docs) that the kit links to. Non-goals: introducing new product features; the kit must not promise roadmap items.

Key stakeholders: Dr. Aisha Rahman (CISO) and Security Engineering (Marcus Lin, Kevin Osei) for technical accuracy; GRC (Olga Petrov, Daniel Carter) for audit/compliance language; Product Security PM (Naomi Feldman) for capability/roadmap alignment; Solutions Engineering (Markus Klein, Fatima Noor, Colin O'Donnell) for deployment-specific details; Product Marketing (Soojin Lee, Camila Reyes) for messaging consistency; Sales leadership and AEs (Jordan Blake, Stephanie Nguyen, Lukas Meyer, Avery Johnson, Priyom Das, Hannah Schmitt) for field readiness; CS leadership (Jasmine Liu, Rachel Kim) for operational handoffs.

Proposed timeline (6–8 weeks): Week 1–2 intake + gap analysis; Week 3–4 drafting and claims-matrix build; Week 5 review cycle + redlines; Week 6 publish + link updates; Week 7–8 sales training and CRM rollout. Constraints: confidentiality controls for restricted evidence, region-specific data residency claims, versioning/change log discipline, and a single source of truth for approved RFP language.
